source.method: Onkelos-supported lexical anchors as starting point; every verse reviewed word by word (reviewed.json)

1:1.note: Subject 'the LORD' moved to first clause.

1:2.note: Distributive 'a man, a man of you'.

1:6.note: Object of cutting not separately rendered.

2:14.note: Aviv rendered by uncertain noun; renderings of the grain free.

3:8.note: Plus 'the LORD at the door' before the tent of meeting.

3:9.note: Syriac 'sacrifice of the burnt-offering' for shelamim; spine rendered 'loins'.

4:3.note: Ashmat ha-am rendered 'debts of the people'.

4:5.note: Plus 'door' of the tent of meeting.

4:11.note: List reordered with 'with', dung placed first.

4:12.note: Shefekh ha-deshen paraphrased 'place where ashes are thrown'.

4:16.note: Plus 'door' of the tent of meeting.

4:26.note: Plus 'which he sinned'; shelamim rendered with 'olah'-type noun.

5:7.note: Leyhwah not rendered; asham rendered 'offering of his sin'.

5:19.note: Asham asham paraphrased 'for sin he brings an offering'.

5:23.note: Free rendering of gezelah as 'what he took by force'.

6:2.note: Plus 'to them'; mokdah rendered 'of burning'; plus copula.

6:13.note: Ephah rendered 'seah'; tamid repeated at end.

6:14.note: Free rendering of tufinei 'break it into pieces'.

7:4.note: Minus 'which is on the loins'; 'their fat' condenses החלב אשר עליהן.

7:7.note: Expanded 'as the sin-offering, so the offering'; plus 'shall be'.

7:10.note: 'Each like his brother' rendered 'each as falls to him'.

7:32.note: Syriac 'to the LORD' for 'to the priest'.

8:2.note: Qach split: 'lead' for persons, plus 'take' for objects.

8:7.note: Plus 'and fastened the girdle on his loins'; robe rendered 'breastplate'; final clause (vayye'pod lo bo) not clearly rendered.

8:8.note: Urim and Thummim rendered 'knowledge and truth'.

8:20.note: Distributive 'limb by limb' for 'into its pieces'.

8:31.note: Tsiveiti read as passive 'I was commanded'.

9:2.note: Tamim rendered 'clean from blemish'; olah rendered 'whole burnt-offering'.

9:12.note: Reordered: 'brought to him the blood the sons of Aaron'.

9:24.note: Fat and burnt-offering transposed; vayaronnu rendered 'praised'.

10:1.note: Plus 'not in its time'; ketoret rendered 'spices'.

10:6.note: Plus 'who were left to him'; yiqtsof rendered 'there be wrath'.

10:18.note: Plus 'that Aaron and his sons should eat it'.

10:19.note: Conditional rendered 'if I had eaten... would it be good'.

11:2.note: Plus 'to them'; periphrastic 'you shall be eating'.

11:3.note: Shesa rendered 'in two'; bebehemah not rendered.

11:11.note: Minus 'and they shall be detestable to you'.

11:14.note: Minus 'and the ayyah after its kind'.

11:40.note: Minus first half (the one who eats of its carcass).

12:2.note: Tazria rendered 'conceive'; niddat dewotah rendered 'her menstruation'.

13:2.note: Skin-disease terms rendered by Syriac equivalents.

13:3.note: Opening verb glossed 'bring' instead of 'see'; plus clause 'if the sore spread in the skin of his flesh'.

13:6.note: Rendered 'after seven other days'; mispachat rendered 'scurf'; plus 'because'.

13:16.note: Yashuv and nehpakh merged into one verb.

13:40.note: Rendered 'his hair falls and he becomes bald'.

13:55.note: Plus 'and the sore has not changed'; qarachat/gabachat read as 'newness/oldness'.

13:57.note: Porachat restructured 'because the sore increased in it'.

14:2.note: 'Law of leprosy' for 'law of the leper'.

14:4.note: 'Let them bring' for 'take'; 'colour of scarlet' renders 'scarlet worm'.

14:6.note: Plus 'other' and 'to them'; resumptive 'it' (5) not rendered.

14:7.note: 'He shall be clean' for 'he shall pronounce him clean'.

14:10.note: 'Without blemish' paraphrase; 'offering' (15) and 'one' (19) minus; 'bowl of oil' for log.

14:11.note: Word-for-word with object marked by lamad.

14:14.note: 'Sprinkle' for 'put'; 'leaf of the ear' for 'tip of the ear'.

14:15.note: 'One bowl of oil' for 'from the log of oil'.

14:21.note: 'One of ten of a seah' renders 'one tenth-measure'; 'bowl' for log.

14:23.note: 'Who shall cleanse him' renders 'for his cleansing'.

14:31.note: MT opening 'what his hand can reach' (1-5) minus; 'before the Lord' moved forward.

14:38.note: 'Stand at its door' paraphrases 'to the door of the house'.

14:49.note: Plus 'living clean' (from v4) and 'and the priest shall command'.

14:51.note: Living bird moved to front; plus 'other'; doubled object ܐܢܘܢ ܠܗܠܝܢ = אתם.

14:57.note: 'To distinguish between unclean and clean' paraphrase.

15:8.note: 'Him who has the issue / him who is clean' periphrases.

15:13.note: 'For his cleansing' as 'and he shall be cleansed'.

15:15.note: 'From his issue' moved before 'before the Lord'; burnt-offering as 'whole sacrifice'.

15:19.note: 'She shall sit in her menstruation' for 'be in her impurity'.

15:25.note: Plus verb 'they are'; final 'she' (24) not rendered.

15:30.note: 'From the issue' moved before 'before the Lord'.

16:2.note: 'Inside from the face of the door' for 'within the veil'.

16:3.note: Plus particle 'then' and periphrastic 'shall be entering'.

16:6.note: 'For himself' rendered 'upon his soul'; plus 'for him'.

16:17.note: Plus 'sons of' and repeated 'he shall atone'.

16:29.note: Sojourner rendered 'those who turn to me (proselytes) who dwell among you'.

17:8.note: Sojourner rendered 'those who turn to me' (proselytes).

17:9.note: 'Offer it before the Lord' for 'do it to the Lord'.

17:10.note: 'My wrath' for 'my face'; 'house' and 'any' minus; proselyte paraphrase.

17:15.note: 'Torn by a beast'; native rendered 'among you'; proselyte paraphrase.

18:9.note: 'Born of your father or of another man' for 'born at home or outside'.

18:14.note: 'Wife of your uncle' for 'father's brother'; plus repeated 'you shall not uncover her nakedness'.

18:18.note: 'To vex her' for 'to be a rival'.

18:21.note: Molech rendered 'to impregnate a foreign woman'.

18:22.note: 'Because it is unclean' for 'it is an abomination'.

18:25.note: 'It repaid its iniquity' for 'I visited its iniquity'.

18:26.note: 'You' (2) not rendered; 'sins' for abominations; proselyte paraphrase.

18:28.note: Restructured: 'do not defile the land lest it vomit you'.

18:29.note: 'One of all these sins' for 'any of these abominations'.

19:2.note: Syriac repeats 'I' (holy am I; I am the Lord).

19:3.note: Father before mother; 'commandments' for sabbaths; plus 'because'.

19:6.note: Plus repeated 'shall be eaten' and 'and shall not be eaten'.

19:10.note: 'Olive trees' for vineyard (2nd); proselyte paraphrase for sojourner; plus 'but'.

19:15.note: 'Nor (accept) the face of the great' for 'honour the great'.

19:16.note: 'Eat pieces' (slander idiom) for 'go about as talebearer'.

19:19.note: 'Do not wear' for 'shall not come upon you'.

19:23.note: 'Leave them three years' paraphrases orlah clause; 15-17 minus.

19:31.note: Restructured: 'do not ask them, lest you be defiled'.

19:32.note: 'Honour him who is older than you' paraphrase.

20:2.note: Molech rendered 'a foreign woman'; proselyte paraphrase; plus 'that man'.

20:3.note: 'My wrath' for 'my face'; Molech rendered 'a foreign woman'.

20:4.note: 'Turn away their eyes' for 'hide their eyes'; Molech rendered 'a foreign woman'.

20:20.note: 'Wife of his uncle' for aunt; 'without sons' for childless.

20:26.note: Plus 'I am the Lord' before 'holy'; 'to me' (2) not rendered.

21:4.note: 'Great one of his people' for 'husband among his people'.

21:18.note: Lame before blind; 'deformed ear' for sarua.

21:20.note: Doublets: 'drooping eyebrows' = second rendering of גבן, 'dim-sighted' of דק (cf. rabbinic exegesis); ܟܘܣܬܢ linked to ילפת by slot only, meaning uncertain.

21:23.note: 'Within the face of the door' for 'to the veil'.

22:7.note: 'At sunset' for 'when the sun goes down'.

22:21.note: 'Goats' for flock; 'whatever has no blemish shall be accepted'.

22:22.note: Defect terms approximate (scabby, loose, leprous, hairless).

22:23.note: 'Deformed ear or short tail' paraphrases sarua/qalut.

23:3.note: 'Holy convocation' rendered 'shall be holy to the Lord'.

23:15.note: 'After the day' for 'morrow after the sabbath'.

23:24.note: 'Day of crying' for teruah; plus 'shall be to you'.

23:26.note: Plus 'speak to the sons of Israel and say to them'.

23:40.note: Plus 'citrons'; 'myrtle' for leafy tree; plus 'all of the house of Israel'.

24:8.note: Plus 'Aaron'; repeated 'on the sabbath day' (3-4) not rendered.

24:16.note: Sojourner/native rendered 'proselyte or son of Israel'; 'my name'.

25:4.note: Plus 'and it shall be to you'.

25:5.note: 'Grapes of your branches' for 'grapes of your unpruned vine'.

25:10.note: Jubilee rendered 'release' (punaya); 'it' (12) and final verb (22) not rendered.

25:30.note: Ketiv lo read as 'which has' (qere); jubilee rendered 'release'.

25:35.note: 'Do not seize him as inhabitant or sojourner' for 'support him'.

25:43.note: 'Make him serve hard service' for 'rule with harshness'.

26:1.note: Kī (H17) unrendered; doubled ܐܢܐ renders אני; ܘܠܐ ܬܣܓܕܘܢ adds negation.

26:2.note: Syriac 'my commandments' for 'my sabbaths'; doubled ܐܢܐ for אני.

26:5.note: לכם unrendered; order of last phrase changed.

26:6.note: Paraphrase 'there shall be none to frighten you'; ܠܟܘܢ plus.

26:13.note: Doubled ܐܢܐ; 'yoke of your servitude' paraphrases bars of your yoke; 'upright stature' for קוממיות.

26:16.note: Four disease nouns for three (ܪܕܝܐ plus); 'appoint' rendering.

26:28.note: אף אני moved to front; 'in fury and contention'.

26:36.note: 'as those fleeing from before the sword'; ܠܗܘܢ plus.

26:44.note: Syriac negates 'destroy' and 'break' (two ܘܠܐ plus); כי אני יהוה אלהיהם shifted to v45.

26:45.note: 'I am the LORD their God' (from MT 44 end) inserted here as plus; ܐܠܐ plus.

27:7.note: 'if it is a male' moved to front.

27:10.note: ולא ימיר אתו unrendered; ܠܡܪܝܐ plus.

27:12.note: 'as the priest fixes her price' paraphrase.

27:20.note: 'and sells it' with suffix for field.
